title: Around the Weed

beats.text: Morning sun on the crate towers. Tiny's crate sits empty. In the pavement crack, the two-leaf weed sways in a patch of light.
A fast engine rev rises from behind the stacks.
Dash drifts around a crate tower, fin blazing, aimed straight at the crack. Its eyes snap round. It brakes hard, a hand's width from the weed.
Dash glances stiffly left, then right, in a clumsy copy of Tiny's eye sweep. At walking pace it steers wide around the crack, then gives one soft rev like a chirp and is gone.
Mossback rolls past on a loop wider than before, tips a thin silver streak of water onto the weed without stopping, and crawls on toward the green treetops of the Grove beyond the stacks.

staging_notes: A short wordless bridge into the finale. Mirror S01's low ground-level framing on the weed, but in warm clear light. Dash's approach is a straight push-in that ends in a stop instead of a streak past. Follow Mossback out of frame toward the treetops so the cut to the golden Grove in S31 feels like one movement.
